units.text: The June 2022 HTTP standard (RFC 9110/9111/9112) defines the DELETE method as a means to delete a resource, but no evidence states that DELETE establishes a tunnel to a server. Tunnel establishment is attributed to the CONNECT method per RFC 9110 §9.3.6 and other spans.

judgement.reason: The passages support that DELETE deletes a resource and that CONNECT establishes a tunnel per RFC 9110 §9.3.6, but they do not explicitly identify RFC 9110/9111/9112 as the June 2022 HTTP standard, and RFC 9111/9112 are not mentioned.

units.text: Spans referencing the 2022 standard (e.g., ef488e59, af84eba1) confirm the standard's definitions and RFC replacements but do not link DELETE to tunnel creation. The CONNECT method, not DELETE, is described as establishing a TCP/IP tunnel.
